result.instructions: Tools for WorkOS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which organizations in our WorkOS environment have an active SSO connection?"; "Show the directory users synced from our Okta directory with the email filter for ana@example.com."; "List the invitations that are still pending for acme.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WorkOS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run workos_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run workos_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run workos_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. workos_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: workos_sync_directory
tools.title: Sync a directory
tools.description: Start a Directory Sync for one directory, so WorkOS pulls the latest users and groups from the identity provider. Repeating it is safe. WorkOS API: POST /directories/{id}/sync.

directory_id.description: The directory id (for example org_01… or conn_01…).

tools.name: workos_revoke_invitation
tools.title: Revoke an invitation
tools.description: Revoke a pending user invitation, so the invite link stops working. This cannot be undone: a new invitation is needed. WorkOS API: POST /user_management/invitations/{id}/revoke.

invitation_id.description: The invitation id (for example org_01… or conn_01…).
